IS : 9664 - 1980

Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR DIAMETERS OF SEALING AREAS FOR USE OF LEATHER CUPS
0. FOREWORD
by the Indian Standards the draft finalized by the approved by the Chemical

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted Institution on 31 December 1980, after Leather Sectional Committee had been Division Council.

0.2 Leather sealing cups are used as gland packing for pneumatic and hydraulic system presses. Sealing cups may be of different shapes and designs depending upon the end use, such as ` U ' cups, c V ' cups, `M' cups, etc. 0.3 This standard lays down the diameters of sealing spaces applicable in general machine construction in which sealing is done with leather sealing cups and in formed impregnated ropes ( including flanged armatures of mountings and other armatures of inner diameters 80 mm and above ), This standard is complementary to IS : 9662 ( Part I )-1981*. 0.4 In the formulation of this standard assistance has been derived the CSN: 029010 diameters of sealing areas, issued by Urad Normalizaci a Mereni Vaclavske Namesti, Czechoslovakia. from Pro

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS: 2-19607. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 1. SCOPE

1.1 This standard prescribes the diameters of sealing spaces in general machine construction while using leather sealing cups and in formed impregnated ropes ( including flanged armatures or mountings and other armatures of inner diameter 80 mm and above ).
*Code `U' cups. iRules of practice for construction and assembly of leather sealing cups for rounding

This table is not applicable for armatures and low pressure air systems. Additional values of sealing areas have been specified in Tables 2 to 4.
